CHECKER.py reproduces all 81 strict candidate inequalities with rational/integer arithmetic, without replacing the analytic all-degree proof.

value.rationale: The quadratic-reproducing King operator is a natural standard positive approximation operator and its worst jump errors are not determined by smooth approximation estimates. A genuinely sharp degree-eight-to-nine migration of the norming cell, its exact one-sided nonattaining nature, and the general beta-quantile representation quantify a natural stability diagnostic without arbitrary parameter slicing. The limit constant and location describe the large-degree regime; higher-degree finite index classification is explicitly left open.
